architecture: One page file, index.html, plus world-110m.json (country outlines). d3 v7 and topojson from cdnjs. No other network calls from the page.
All data lives in this artifact's database. Scheduled tasks write it; the page reads it live and re-renders on change.
Every document is passed through a clean*() function in the page before use, so malformed data is dropped, not shown. New fields must be added there.
Each panel renders inside safe(), so one failing panel shows a notice instead of blanking the page.

collections.brief/latest: Daily brief: generated_at, date, headline, plain_summary, items[{title,why,action,event_id}].
collections.data/users/<uid>/watchlist: Per-viewer watchlist terms. The only path viewers can write besides reports.
collections.events/<id>: One per event. Fields: title, date, date_note, occurred_at, time_basis, category (incident|outage|vuln|report|policy|investment|enforcement), severity 1-3, status (confirmed|official|developing|claimed), org, sector, country, place, lat, lng, geo_basis, pin_type, actor, summary, plain, exec, action, impact, records_affected, products[], attack[], tags[], cves[], cve_meta[{id,cvss,epss,kev,kev_due}], sources[{name,url}], source_tier, validation{state,checked_at,note}, report{publisher,publisher_type,doc_id,published,key_findings[],recommendations[],iocs_available,read_depth,url}, report_recheck, first_seen, updated_at.
collections.kev/<CVE id>: CISA known-exploited catalog entries from the last 45 days: cve, vendor, product, name, added, due, ransomware, desc, cvss, epss.
collections.meta/status: Last-run timestamps per task (last_sweep_at, last_validation_at, last_feeds_at, last_kev_at, last_analysis_at, last_reports_at, last_deep_sweep_at, last_brief_at, last_maintenance_at), notes, health.
collections.reports/<id>: Reader error reports, reviewed by the validation pass.

design_decisions: Appearance: light and dark glass, system font, validated colour-blind-safe category palette; category is always also shown by shape.
Charts lead with the question they answer and print their caveats underneath.
Bar charts are single-colour columns; breakdowns go in tooltips.
No viewer-side workflow state (handled/patched) by owner's decision on 2026-11-17.
Refresh reloads data and resets to the main map view.
how_to_update_the_page: Edit index.html. Configuration tables (CATS, LAYERS, SECG, LENS) are at the top of the script.
Bump BUILD.version and BUILD.date in the script.
Run the regression suite (test_all.py: both appearances, phone width, missing data, no connection, 190 events). It must print ALL PASS.
Publish index.html to artifact slug 480095d5-6613-4f00-b113-f4ee0e03aa61 with the current live version as base_version.
To change a scheduled task, append or replace a clearly labelled paragraph and resend the whole prompt; verify the stored prompt afterwards.
known_limits: The live page has only been verified through a local test copy with stubbed data, not in a signed-in browser.
Scheduled tasks cannot use a real browser, so pages that need one (CISA's advisory list sometimes, Europol, HHS) rely on fallbacks.
Germany's BSI, Australia's cyber.gov.au and SAP notes block automated readers.
Attack-surface and sector rows come from each event's sectors and surface (stated by the source or inferred by CyberView AI); events without them are placed by keyword and labelled keyword-assigned.
Coverage is thin for Africa, Turkey, most of the Middle East and Latin America.
purpose: Rolling seven-day world map of publicly reported cyber events for defenders. Read-only for viewers: no marking of items as handled. Owner: Xander.
rules_for_data: Facts only from pages actually retrieved; never invent a document number, finding or URL.
Outages are category outage and never called attacks unless an official source says so.
Attacker claims: status claimed, severity 1, hidden by default.
Prefer the original government or vendor document; record how deeply it was read in report.read_depth.
When an original contradicts an entry, fix the entry and add a corrections document.
Never delete documents. Use ifVersion on existing documents; at most 15-20 operations per write.
Slow or failing sites: retry after 60 then 120 seconds; do not work around sites that block automated readers.
